models_evaluated: Stratification Tool for Opioid Risk Mitigation (STORM)

links.outcome: Change in opioid dose, SUD treatment, and risk mitigation after interdisciplinary review of very high-risk patients
links.effect: Mean MEDD fell from 82.2 mg to 7.5 mg (90.9% reduction); medications for SUD rose in 3 patients (23%); SUD engagement rose from 3 to 6 patients; urine drug tests up 79%; benzodiazepine use down 50%. No comparator group.
links.quote: A reduction in MEDD, increase in SUD treatment, and improved risk mitigation was observed.

unlisted_practices: Mandated interdisciplinary team case review of patients flagged very high risk by a predictive tool, led by clinical pharmacist practitioners

screen.practice: interdisciplinary team review of high-risk patients flagged by STORM
screen.reason: Evaluates the clinical implementation and outcomes of a mandatory interdisciplinary team review process following risk stratification by the STORM predictive decision support tool in real clinical practice.

primary.practice: interdisciplinary team review of high-risk predictive model alerts
